require 'openssl'
require 'base64'
require 'connection_pool'
require 'json'
require 'securerandom'

module CIPipeline
  class EncryptedArtifactStore
    BLOCK_SIZE = 16
    POOL_SIZE = 5
    POOL_TIMEOUT = 3

    def initialize(master_key_hex)
      @master_key = [master_key_hex].pack('H*')
      @pool = ConnectionPool.new(size: POOL_SIZE, timeout: POOL_TIMEOUT) do
        Connection.new(@master_key)
      end
    end

    def store_artifact(pipeline_id, artifact_data)
      @pool.with do |conn|
        encrypted = conn.encrypt_artifact(artifact_data)
        manifest = {
          pipeline_id: pipeline_id,
          stored_at: Time.now.utc.iso8601,
          payload: Base64.strict_encode64(encrypted),
          checksum: OpenSSL::Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(artifact_data)
        }
        persist_manifest(manifest)
      end
    end

    def retrieve_artifact(pipeline_id, encrypted_payload_b64)
      @pool.with do |conn|
        raw = Base64.strict_decode64(encrypted_payload_b64)
        result = conn.decrypt_artifact(raw)
        return result
      end
    end

    def validate_artifact_integrity(pipeline_id, encrypted_payload_b64)
      @pool.with do |conn|
        raw = Base64.strict_decode64(encrypted_payload_b64)
        validation = conn.validate_and_decrypt(raw)
        validation
      end
    end

    private

    def persist_manifest(manifest)
      # In production, writes to artifact registry
      manifest.to_json
    end
  end

  class Connection
    BLOCK_SIZE = 16

    def initialize(key)
      @key = key
      @cipher_encrypt = nil
      @cipher_decrypt = nil
      @request_count = 0
    end

    def encrypt_artifact(plaintext)
      cipher = OpenSSL::Cipher::AES.new(256, :CBC)
      cipher.encrypt
      cipher.key = @key
      iv = cipher.random_iv
      cipher.padding = 1
      ciphertext = cipher.update(plaintext) + cipher.final
      iv + ciphertext
    end

    def decrypt_artifact(data)
      @request_count += 1
      iv = data[0...BLOCK_SIZE]
      ciphertext = data[BLOCK_SIZE..-1]

      cipher = OpenSSL::Cipher::AES.new(256, :CBC)
      cipher.decrypt
      cipher.key = @key
      cipher.iv = iv
      cipher.padding = 1

      begin
        plaintext = cipher.update(ciphertext) + cipher.final
        plaintext
      rescue OpenSSL::Cipher::CipherError => e
        nil
      end
    end

    def validate_and_decrypt(data)
      @request_count += 1
      return { valid: false, error: 'too_short' } if data.length < BLOCK_SIZE * 2
      return { valid: false, error: 'alignment' } if data.length % BLOCK_SIZE != 0

      iv = data[0...BLOCK_SIZE]
      ciphertext = data[BLOCK_SIZE..-1]

      cipher = OpenSSL::Cipher::AES.new(256, :CBC)
      cipher.decrypt
      cipher.key = @key
      cipher.iv = iv
      cipher.padding = 1

      begin
        plaintext = cipher.update(ciphertext) + cipher.final
        { valid: true, size: plaintext.bytesize, artifact: plaintext }
      rescue OpenSSL::Cipher::CipherError => e
        if padding_error?(e)
          { valid: false, error: 'integrity_check_failed' }
        else
          { valid: false, error: 'decryption_failed' }
        end
      end
    end

    private

    def padding_error?(exception)
      exception.message.downcase.include?('padding') ||
        exception.message.downcase.include?('wrong final block') ||
        exception.message.downcase.include?('bad decrypt')
    end
  end

  class PipelineWebhookHandler
    def initialize(store)
      @store = store
    end

    def handle_validation_request(params)
      pipeline_id = params[:pipeline_id]
      payload = params[:payload]

      return { status: 400, body: 'missing params' } unless pipeline_id && payload

      start_time = Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC)
      result = @store.validate_artifact_integrity(pipeline_id, payload)
      elapsed = Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC) - start_time

      if result[:valid]
        { status: 200, body: { valid: true, size: result[:size] }.to_json }
      else
        { status: 422, body: { valid: false, reason: result[:error] }.to_json }
      end
    end

    def handle_retrieve_request(params)
      pipeline_id = params[:pipeline_id]
      payload = params[:payload]

      return { status: 400, body: 'missing params' } unless pipeline_id && payload

      artifact = @store.retrieve_artifact(pipeline_id, payload)
      if artifact
        { status: 200, body: artifact }
      else
        { status: 404, body: 'not found' }
      end
    end
  end
end
